name: v0.3.0
body:
## Highlights

- **Speech-LLM transcription with [Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 30B-A4B](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B).** Transcribes complete recordings of up to one hour with punctuation and capitalization, and adds word timestamps, speaker labels, speech translation and supports custom instructions. It runs through `nemo-speech transcribe`, the HTTP server (including `/v1/chat/completions`) and `riva_server`. The default CUDA build decodes many requests together, with MTP or DFlash2 speculative decoding. See the [SALM guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/NeMo-Speech.cpp/blob/v0.3.0/docs/salm/README.md). (#82, #84, #85)
- **Speaker labels in text, SRT and WebVTT.** With `--diarize`, text output has one `Speaker N: ...` paragraph per turn, SRT cues start with `Speaker N: ` and WebVTT cues use `<v Speaker N>`. A cue never spans a speaker change, and the CLI and HTTP server share one subtitle renderer. (#87)
- **Zero-copy ASR weights.** ASR models memory-map their GGUF and bind weights directly on CPU and Metal, instead of holding a second copy in memory. (#47)
- **MagpieTTS and NanoCodec on integrated NVIDIA GPUs.** On unified-memory devices such as DGX Spark, TTS now runs on the GPU instead of silently falling back to the CPU. (#65)
- **Faster offline diarization front end.** The mel extractor computes the power spectrum once per frame instead of once per mel band, and stream buffers are compacted lazily. (#62)

## Fixes

- Streaming ASR no longer drops speech at the start of a stream, and Q8 pointwise layers keep their precision. (#46)
- Word times stay inside the audio: the end-of-stream flush could place them up to 1.3 s past the end. Words at speaker changes on cache-aware models now get the right speaker. (#87)
- Long recordings without endpointing no longer collapse to one speaker after about 10 minutes (word speaker accuracy on AMI ES2002a: 59.2% → 99.7%). (#70)
- MagpieTTS v2607 conversion maps speakers to the right ids. (#66)
- The NanoCodec decoder fails a decode that produces NaN or infinite samples, instead of returning them clamped to full-scale audio. (#43)
- Text normalization no longer inserts "sil" for an isolated comma; OpenFST and Sparrowhawk come from updated repositories. (#69)

## Notes

- **cuBLAS in the Linux CUDA archives and the container.** They now ship NVIDIA's cuBLAS and cuBLASLt instead of the in-tree shim due to performance concerns, so they are larger. (#88)

## New Contributors
* @dashidhy made their first contribution in https://github.com/NVIDIA/NeMo-Speech.cpp/pull/46
* @Eoin-Houstoun made their first contribution in https://github.com/NVIDIA/NeMo-Speech.cpp/pull/62
* @femo23 made their first contribution in https://github.com/NVIDIA/NeMo-Speech.cpp/pull/65

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NVIDIA/NeMo-Speech.cpp/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.0
